description: Defines the IdSpan struct which represents a sequence of bytes as a primitive identity type, including serialization, comparison, and formatting functionalities.

classes.name: IdSpan
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a sequence of bytes for identities, with serialization, comparison, and formatting capabilities.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan instance from a string by encoding it as UTF8 bytes.

methods.name: AsSpan
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySpan<byte> representing the underlying value.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another IdSpan based on underlying byte array.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the precomputed hash code of the IdSpan.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code as an unchecked uint for uniform hashing purposes.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Decodes the byte array as UTF8 and returns it as a string.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the IdSpan as a UTF8 string into a provided span.
